privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Thesis References' collection starts with 12 papers. The 4 papers to be removed are: 1. 'On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies' (Einstein, 1905), 2. 'Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids...' (Watson & Crick, 1953), 3. 'Generative Adversarial Nets' (Goodfellow et al., 2014), and 4. 'Mastering the Game of Go...' (Silver et al., 2016). After removal, the collection must contain exactly 8 papers. The papers must remain in the main library, so the agent should not use 'Delete' or 'Move to Trash' functions.
